title: Replacement-depth rows built only from official nfl.com text read on 2026-11-14
method: A replacement row is published only when an official nfl.com article or the official injury report explicitly states (a) the starter will not play or is on IR, and (b) who replaces him. The depth column records HOW DEEP the replacement is (starter / 1st backup / 2nd backup / 3rd backup) ONLY when the official text states the depth; otherwise the depth cell is blank and flagged. No depth is inferred from rosters or third-party depth charts.

blank_policy_note: Every blank cell above is deliberate: the official source read this session does not state the value. Blanks are flagged on the Flagged for Review page and are never filled by inference.
